title: Li3PS4: superionic transition, ionic conductivity and the paddle-wheel question

decision_points.fork: Which conductivity answers the question: Nernst-Einstein (tracer) or Green-Kubo (charge current)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the cheaper, smoother Nernst-Einstein series as sigma (H_R = 1)
decision_points.consequence: Predictions low by the Haven ratio (-0.26 to -0.29 dex); superionic E_a 0.28 eV instead of ~0.18 eV (H_R rises with T); H_R = 1
decision_points.difficulty_type: convention, with a cascade into E_a

decision_points.fork: Which Green-Kubo points below the transition are resolved
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit every positive Green-Kubo value below the transition
decision_points.consequence: Below ~600 K the gamma-started Green-Kubo values sit at a ~0.03 S/m noise floor (apparent H_R > 1); including them gives E_a ~0.16 eV instead of ~1.6 eV
decision_points.difficulty_type: regime judgement discovered in the data

decision_points.fork: Which heat-capacity anomaly is the superionic transition
decision_points.consequence: For every reference the largest Cp peak is melting of the PS4 sublattice (coincides with P diffusion and free rotation): Tc 875/925 K instead of 737.5/787.5 K, and the withheld runs are then predicted from the low-temperature branch
decision_points.difficulty_type: confounder that mimics the target; discriminating purchase (D_P, angle step)

decision_points.fork: Whether the transition depends on the DFT reference
decision_points.wrong_choice: Transfer one reference's transition (PBEsol) or the experimental alpha transition (746 K) to all
decision_points.consequence: Tc off by 125-175 K (PBEsol transfer) or 41.5 K for r2SCAN (experimental value); budget must be split over references
decision_points.difficulty_type: discovered in the data under a binding budget

decision_points.fork: On which side of the jump each withheld run lies
decision_points.wrong_choice: Interpolate log sigma in 1/T between the neighbouring served temperatures
decision_points.consequence: Each withheld run is the first temperature above its transition; interpolation across the jump is low by 0.27-0.52 dex. Resolving it requires buying a discriminating observable at that temperature (angle fluctuation, Cp of the interval, order parameters or the 750 K MSD)
decision_points.difficulty_type: discriminating experiment; cascade from the transition location

decision_points.fork: Whether runs from different starting phases reach the same superionic state
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use alpha-started runs as the superionic reference for the gamma-started cells
decision_points.consequence: Alpha-started runs stay in a different, more conductive state: predictions high by 0.25-0.31 dex and H_R 0.37 instead of 0.53

decision_points.fork: Frame for attributing conduction to Li-anion coupling
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the Li-S term in the barycentric frame as dynamical coupling
decision_points.consequence: Li-S fraction 0.27 (equal to the kinematic recoil of the matrix, fixed by the masses) instead of ~0.05; a spurious argument for the paddle-wheel picture
decision_points.difficulty_type: confounder that mimics the target effect

decision_points.fork: Which PS4 motion to compare with Li hops
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compare with the PS4 libration rate implied by the angle fluctuation
decision_points.consequence: Rate ratio ~10^-0.3 (hops no faster than PS4 motion) instead of ~10^2.7; paddle-wheel wrongly supported

decision_points.fork: One Arrhenius law or separate phases
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit one Arrhenius law through the transition for the gamma-started runs
decision_points.consequence: Single E_a ~0.65 eV for both regimes (true ~1.6 and ~0.18 eV); transition and superionic barrier missed

graded_fields: sigma_predictions_S_per_m: each of 3 withheld runs within +/-0.15 dex
runtime_dependencies: numpy (runtime image); the lab is a lookup of archived values
notes: Adapted from the design: the archive holds no trajectories, only figure-level analyses, so the lab serves them per run and the withheld runs are the first temperature above each transition. PBE0 is graded with Green-Kubo activation energies (the paper tabulates Nernst-Einstein ones, 1.43/0.269 eV). The hop/flip ratio is graded at 800 K in the superionic phase (600 K, as in the design, lies below the PBE0 transition, where D_omega is librational). Beta-started runs above 625 K are not served because the archived r2SCAN and PBE0 beta series coincide there.
